messages:
lina-support: FYI customer org=acme-inc hit repeated 422s from our tool executor in production starting ~2026-03-15T10:12Z. Request ID=recq_01G8VQ8ZQK7Q1ABCDE. They say calls that used to work with tool A suddenly started failing with schema errors.

matt-eng: can you paste the original request body & the error log?

lina-support: here's redacted body (kept structure):
```json
{ "model": "gpt-open-25b", "input": "Get user profile", "tool_call": { "name": "get_user", "args": ["{\"user_id\": \"u-123\"}"] } }
```
and the router log: `tool_executor: schema validation failed: expected object for 'args' but got array`

eli-ml: hunch: tool registry schema for get_user was updated from accepting raw string -> object, and client SDKs are still sending the old payload (stringified inside array). Could be schema drift between registry v2 and v3.

jess-oncall: deploy-bot, any recent rollout that touched tool registry or the router's validation layer?

deploy-bot: 2026-03-15T09:58Z deploy complete: service=tool-registry version=2026.03.15+rev12 by matt-eng. Change: stricter schema enforcement on tool args (PR #812).

matt-eng: that matches. We tightened validation to require a JSON object for args instead of allowing stringified payloads. Customer clients are still sending args as array of strings (double-encoded).

lina-support: customer reports ~1200 failed calls in last hour, source region us-west-2, impacting live API. They want a mitigation.

eli-ml: mitigation options: 1) server-side leniency: coerce single-element string arrays by parsing JSON if possible. 2) temporary rollback of strict validation. 3) advise customer to patch SDK. Quickest is (1) as hotfix.

jess-oncall: agree. Can we ship a conservative shim that only applies when tool name matches known legacy patterns? Avoid global permissive parsing.

matt-eng: I can push a hotfix to router that does: if args is array and length==1 and typeof element==string then try JSON.parse(element) and revalidate. I'll open a small change and roll to canary.

lina-support: thanks, please also add logging to capture both forms so we can contact affected customers. Customer asked for immediate workaround: is there a header they can set to bypass tool selection so calls go to text-only generation?

eli-ml: you can set `X-Redwood-Tool-Mode: off` for now; that will treat tool_call sections as opaque text and route to regular generation flow. It's not ideal but unblocks them while we patch.

matt-eng: hotfix PR #827 created. Patch function:
```js
// pseudo
if (payload.tool_call && Array.isArray(payload.tool_call.args)) {
  const a = payload.tool_call.args;
  if (a.length === 1 && typeof a[0] === 'string') {
    try { payload.tool_call.args = JSON.parse(a[0]); }
    catch(e) { /* leave as-is -> validation fail */ }
  }
}
```
Deploying canary to 3 routers in us-west-2 now.

deploy-bot: rolling update started: routers-usw2-canary x3 -> versions 2026.03.15+rev13

lina-support: customer switched headers to `X-Redwood-Tool-Mode: off` and confirmed immediate reduction in errors. Still want the hotfix though.

jess-oncall: monitor error rate for recq_01G8VQ8ZQK7Q1ABCDE and org=acme-inc. If >10% errors after canary for 10m, revert.

matt-eng: canary looks good for 12m, errors down to 0.5% for that org. Rolling to production in 3 waves.

eli-ml: follow-up: create migration guide for SDKs and add compatibility tests to our pre-deploy CI to catch double-encoded args. Also tag the tool registry change in release notes.

lina-support: I'll send patched repro steps and the temporary header to the customer; asked them to keep us posted if anything else pops up.

matt-eng: after prod rollout, I'll open task to add a feature flag that allows strict/schema-only enforcement per-customer so we can opt-in.

jess-oncall: good. Root cause = schema enforcement tightened without coordinated SDK bump + missing compatibility shim. Resolution = router shim hotfix + customer header workaround + follow-up SDK docs and CI tests.

lina-support: marking this thread resolved for now. I'll attach customer confirmation when I get it. :white_check_mark:
